selected.item: Voxtral 3 audio family (Public Preview): Voxtral TTS 3 (voxtral-mini-tts-3-0) with zero-shot voice cloning, streaming and contextual delivery; Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 (voxtral-mini-transcribe-3-0) offline transcription and diarization with timestamps; Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime 3 (voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-3-0) real-time transcription; Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 (voxtral-small-transcribe-3-0) offline transcription and diarization with timestamps. Same date also lists Voice Agents managed real-time pipeline, noted but not featured.

12-hour prompt caching in the Responses API (v1/responses): shared instructions, tools and context stay cached longer for lower cached-input pricing even when requests are hours apart; 12-hour cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update and opening up the in-house search API: DeepSeek web and API search powered by the in-house DeepSeek search engine; V4.1 Flash upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 with benchmark gains and shorter task runtime and output length; API calling method (deepseek-flash) and pricing unchanged.
